name: deploy-center
title: Deploy Center
description: See which Vercel and Render projects have commits waiting, and deploy them by hand with Deploy Center.
author: pschmetzer

commands.name: waiting-deploys
commands.title: Waiting Deploys
commands.subtitle: Deploy Center
commands.description: Projects with commits or pull requests that are not live yet. Deploy, open, or copy release notes.

commands.name: deploy-status
commands.title: Deploy Status
commands.subtitle: Deploy Center
commands.description: Projects that are building right now, and projects whose newest deploy failed.

commands.name: deploy-all-changed
commands.title: Deploy All Changed
commands.subtitle: Deploy Center
commands.description: Shows every project with waiting commits, then deploys all of them after you confirm.

preferences.name: deploysPath
preferences.title: Path to deploys
preferences.description: Where the deploys CLI is. Leave empty to look in Deploy Center.app (in /Applications or ~/Applications), then on PATH.

preferences.name: extraPath
preferences.title: Extra PATH
preferences.description: Folders, separated by colons, where deploys finds vercel, gh and jq. Homebrew's folders are always added.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
